title: Girl group trivia night: what should we ask you first?
body:
Hi, this is the KpopQuiz team. This account covers girl groups and trivia, and we read every reply.

We are building the next round of girl group questions and we want to start from what you find hard, not from what we find easy. Tell us one girl group question that once stumped you: a debut year, a member line-up, a title track you mixed up with another one.

Good ideas may find their way into a future quiz.

title: The second generation in six debuts
body:
A short timeline from the KpopQuiz team, for anyone who started with fourth generation groups and wants the backstory. Every date below links to its source.

- TVXQ: 26 December 2003, at a showcase shared with BoA and Britney Spears, under SM Entertainment.
- Super Junior: 6 November 2005, on SBS Inkigayo.
- BIGBANG: 19 August 2006, at the YG Family 10th anniversary concert.
- Wonder Girls: their single album The Wonder Begins came out on 13 February 2007 (JYP).
- Girls' Generation: 5 August 2007, on Inkigayo with "Into the New World", nine members at the time.
- SHINee: 25 May 2008, first stage on Inkigayo with "Replay".

Six debuts in under five years, from three agencies: SM, YG and JYP.

Which of these debuts would you put in a quiz first?

title: SEVENTEEN's three units, explained
body:
A quick guide from the KpopQuiz team for newer fans and for anyone preparing for our SEVENTEEN quizzes. Sources are linked below.

SEVENTEEN is a 13 member group under Pledis Entertainment. They debuted with a live showcase on 26 May 2015, and their first EP, 17 Carat, came out on 29 May 2015.

The group is split into three units:
- the hip-hop unit,
- the vocal unit,
- the performance unit.

Each unit releases and performs on its own, and the thirteen come together for the group's title tracks. That structure is why SEVENTEEN questions on this site often ask which unit a member belongs to.

Which unit do you know best?

title: EXO and SHINee: two SM boy group debuts, four years apart
body:
A short history from the KpopQuiz team. Sources are linked below.

SHINee came first. Their single "Replay" came out on 22 May 2008, and their first stage was on Inkigayo on 25 May 2008.

EXO followed in 2012 with an idea that was new at the time: two sub-units, EXO-K and EXO-M, debuting together. They released "MAMA" on 8 April 2012, with twelve members at debut.

Both groups came from SM Entertainment, four years apart, and both are in our boy group quizzes and blindtest playlists.

Which debut song do you know better, "Replay" or "MAMA"?

title: BTS in four dates
body:
Four dates from the KpopQuiz team, each with its source.

- 12 June 2013: BTS release their single album 2 Cool 4 Skool, with the lead single "No More Dream", through Big Hit. Their first stage follows on 13 June on M Countdown.
- 2013 to 2014: the School trilogy, 2 Cool 4 Skool, O!RUL8,2? and Skool Luv Affair.
- 2015 to 2016: The Most Beautiful Moment in Life series, which Wikipedia calls their youth trilogy.
- 21 August 2020: "Dynamite" comes out. It debuts at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, which Wikipedia describes as making BTS the first all-South Korean act to top that chart.

Our BTS quizzes use these dates. Which BTS milestone would you add to a quiz?

title: Red Velvet's two sides
body:
A short guide from the KpopQuiz team. Sources are linked below.

Red Velvet debuted under SM Entertainment on 1 August 2014, with "Happiness" on Music Bank.

The group's name describes its two sides. As Wikipedia puts it, the "red" side is bright, bold pop, and the "velvet" side is smoother, with R&B and ballads influenced by the 1990s.

That split is useful in a blindtest: if a clip sounds like a bright pop song, think of the red side; if it is slower and smoother, think velvet.

Which side do you play more often?

title: Five girl group facts for your next quiz
body:
Five facts from the KpopQuiz team, each with its source. Useful before you try our girl group quizzes.

1. Girls' Generation were originally a nine member group when they debuted in 2007.
2. Wonder Girls' "Nobody" (English version) entered the Billboard Hot 100 at number 76 on the chart dated 31 October 2009. Wikipedia calls it the first K-pop song on that chart.
3. TWICE were formed through the Mnet survival show Sixteen, which aired from May to July 2015.
4. BLACKPINK debuted on 8 August 2016 with the single album Square One, which had two singles: "Whistle" and "Boombayah".
5. aespa debuted on 17 November 2020 with "Black Mamba".

Which of the five did you already know?

title: ATEEZ in brief
body:
A short guide from the KpopQuiz team. Sources are linked below.

ATEEZ are an eight member group under KQ Entertainment. They debuted on 24 October 2018 with the EP Treasure EP.1: All to Zero, which had two lead singles: "Pirate King" and "Treasure".

The Treasure name runs through their early releases, so it is a common trap in our ATEEZ quizzes: check the full album title before you answer.

Which ATEEZ release do you know best?
